==================
Dictionary unpacking in a dictionary comprehension
==================

{**x for x in y if z}
---

(module
  (expression_statement
    (dictionary_comprehension
      (dictionary_splat
        (identifier))
      (for_in_clause
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (if_clause
        (identifier)))))

==================
Starred set and list comprehension bodies
==================

{*x for x in y}
[*x for x in y]
---

(module
  (expression_statement
    (set_comprehension
      (list_splat
        (identifier))
      (for_in_clause
        (identifier)
        (identifier))))
  (expression_statement
    (list_comprehension
      (list_splat
        (identifier))
      (for_in_clause
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))))
